title: Quality indexes Q7: link each fix to the ship it repairs, for the escape rate and the false-PASS rate
summary: The loop repairs forward: 0 of 695 first-parent commits in 30 days are reverts. Nothing links a fix item to the ship that caused the defect, so OQ1 (escapes per 100 ships) and JQ2 (false-PASS rate) have no data. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-quality-indexes.md §9 JQ2 and §10 OQ1. The lint half has no dependency on Q1; only OQ1 and JQ2 need it.
fix: Add an optional inbox field escapes (a list of commit shas or PR numbers) and a commit trailer Fixes-Ship: <sha>. The inbox lint warns on an item whose source names a commit or PR and that has no escapes field. Compute OQ1 and JQ2 over ships 14 to 44 days old.
acceptance: RED first: an inbox item whose source names a shipped commit and has no escapes field fails evolve inbox lint with one WARN
A Fixes-Ship trailer on a commit marks the named ship as an escape
JQ2 counts a PASS ship as false when a revert, a Fixes-Ship link or a red main CI run that starts at the ship follows within 14 days
Both indexes start at stage shadow
